feeding_claim.verbatim: We graze our cattle on large, stress free pastures with native grasses year round.

notes: Fifth generation family cow/calf operation in Jeff Davis Parish, Southwest Louisiana. Checked the homepage, about page, products page and contact page. The Barn2Door shop page could not be fetched, so the Verifier should check it for fulfillment options and any shipping or delivery. The site calls the beef locally grown, grass-fed beef and says cattle graze native pastures year round, but says nothing about finishing, so the category is grass-fed. The products page offers half and quarter animals at $9.25 per pound including cutting and vacuum packing, and says to call before stopping by the farm. The town Iowa, LA appears in the contact address. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary, not raw text.
